schema.title: Category

post.description:
One persisted assistant turn: store the message, plan, search the catalog,
store the reply. Omit `conversation_id` to start a new conversation.

AccessLevel.title: AccessLevel
AccessLevel.description: What the current user may do with a document, strongest first.

conversation_id.title: Conversation Id
conversation_id.description: Continue this conversation. Omit to start a new one.

needs_connection.title: Needs Connection
needs_connection.description: Toolkits behind the tools above that the user has not connected yet.

callback_url.title: Callback Url
callback_url.description: Where Composio sends the user after they authorize.

ConnectionFilter.title: ConnectionFilter
ConnectionFilter.description: `not_connected` means "needs a connection the user does not have yet".

status.title: Status
status.description: INITIALIZING, INITIATED, ACTIVE, FAILED, EXPIRED, INACTIVE or REVOKED.

ConnectionResponse.title: ConnectionResponse
ConnectionResponse.description: A connection's status. Credentials never leave Composio, so none appear here.

title.title: Title
title.description: Omit to get the default title; a conversation started by chat takes its first message.

DocumentVisibility.title: DocumentVisibility
DocumentVisibility.description: `private`: the owner and the people it is shared with. `firm`: every member.

FirmRegistration.title: FirmRegistration
FirmRegistration.description: An admin registers the firm and becomes its first member in one step.

IngestionOptions.title: IngestionOptions
IngestionOptions.description:
How to chunk and index a document. Unset fields take the mode's defaults.

smart:   Smart Digest reads a sample and proposes strategy and sizes, plus the
         metric unless `distance_metric` pins one. The plan waits for review.
default: recursive, 512 tokens, 64 overlap, cosine.
custom:  the uploader's own strategy, sizes and metric.

IngestionStatus.title: IngestionStatus
IngestionStatus.description:
Smart Digest: analyzing -> analyzed (the plan waits for the uploader) -> queued.
Default and custom start at queued. Then processing -> ready, failed or unsupported.

InviteAcceptance.title: InviteAcceptance
InviteAcceptance.description: The email comes from the invite, so the invitee cannot join as someone else.

InviteCreated.title: InviteCreated
InviteCreated.description: Returned once: only the token hash is stored, so the link cannot be shown again.

MemberResponse.title: MemberResponse
MemberResponse.description: A row of the firm's member list.

PlanChanges.title: PlanChanges
PlanChanges.description: What the uploader changed in Smart Digest's plan before indexing. Unset keeps it.

include_schemas.title: Include Schemas
include_schemas.description: Also return each tool's input and output parameters.

UserSummary.title: UserSummary
UserSummary.description: Who someone is, for pickers and owner labels inside a firm.
